author: Drafted with mentor; reviewed by PM
description: Clean case: complete, clear, written instructions with no conflicts and no medical instructions. Tests that the AI captures everything WITHOUT inventing items, false conflicts, false medical labels, or extra 'Ask the clinic' gaps.

must_not: Create a patient task from 'Our staff will verify your insurance before your visit.' (the clinic does this, not the patient)
Create a patient task from 'We will send you a reminder text two days before your visit.' (the clinic does this)
Label any item as a medical instruction (there are none)
Add 'Ask the clinic' items for topics that ARE covered (false gaps), for example photo ID, parking, or forms
Add skincare or treatment advice of any kind
scoring_notes: Completeness = required items found / 6. Optional items (E7, E8) are neither required nor penalized. This set mainly measures PRECISION: count invented items, false conflicts, false medical labels, and false gaps. Target: zero of each.
